text: In effect the whole thing amounted to paying for a reference. People at the time were forced to ask around in order to find a reliable outfit. So the firm went on writing the stories that those people needed to see. That is the only way the whole scheme could be said to have paid off. Later on the game changed in ways that made such a thing quite impossible. But the result that came from it then was plain and to the point. The stories got around and the rest followed on from them. No other sort of arrangement would have managed to get the work done.
reasoning:
We need to continue the essay exactly from the given excerpt. The excerpt ends with "In". So the continuation should start with a word that fits grammatically after "In". Likely "In other words" or "In short". Need to match the voice, which is a somewhat cynical and pragmatic account of old internet marketing. The previous sentences mention getting found by getting press, and having to pay a PR firm. The final fragment "In" points to an explanation of that arrangement or a subsequent result. If the PR firm worked because the reporters liked them, the next step might be an example of that press. The text should not introduce any made-up numbers or stories. It is enough to say that this press then sent out customers. The customers had been looking for such a service in the only way available at the time. This was far different from the more self directed methods that would come later. The whole thing needs to stay strictly within the facts already established. The writing should sound like a person reflecting on the past without getting carried away.

The fragment In needs a noun to follow. The most direct one would be an explanation of the actual result. That result was that the press coverage did in fact deliver the required number of users. The whole strategy depended on the fact that people could not find the service any other way. Once the story got out the rest followed naturally. There was no need to try and force the issue through other channels. The fact that the reporters were willing to use the service simply made the arrangement work out. This sort of thing could not be repeated in the more complex environment that followed. It stands as a fairly good example of the methods that prevailed at the time.
